_comment: G4 SEED emission-spec corpus (po-av01j.5): test-grade, hand-authored, sufficient for the per-language e2e tests. Covers RC-027 (centralized error monitoring: error paths that capture vs swallow), RC-046 (distributed tracing at I/O boundaries), and the emission half of RC-061 (LLM observability; the call-site half rides G1). PRODUCTION corpus authoring rides the LLM factory with human review - see the follow-up bead under po-av01j.

emissions.rationale: a recover() with no capture or log emission swallows the panic: the error path is invisible to any monitoring (RC-027)
an except block that neither emits nor re-raises swallows the failure: invisible to centralized error monitoring (RC-027)
a catch that neither emits nor re-throws swallows the failure: invisible to centralized error monitoring (RC-027)
